profile.headline: Software Engineer at Trimble
profile.summary:
Motivated and analytic .NET Software Developer, with nine (9) years of experience developing software under both Web (Desktop and Mobile) and Windows environments. I love solving problems using different programming languages (https://www.hackerrank.com/yosuan8718).
- Strong knowledge of .NET Framework, Object-Oriented Paradigm, and Relational Database Management Systems.
- Solid experience in Web technologies: ASP.NET, JavaScript, jQuery, ExtJS, Sencha Touch, HTML, Bootstrap.
- Good experience in SQL language and database products: SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
positions.description:
- Full Stack Developer in .NET.
- Implemented several modules for Syncrasy (web-based application that works with medical data) using ASP.NET Web Forms, ASP.NET Web API, Entity Framework, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX and Bootstrap.
- Designed and developed modules for Syncrasy Backend (web-based application to manage Syncrasy configurations) using ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, Entity Framework, Dapper, JavaScript, jQuery and Bootstrap.
- Implemented tools to deploy reports to SSRS and Tableau servers, and to deploy DB changes to SQL Server and Azure automatically using Tableau REST API, TFS REST API and SSRS REST API.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web developer - September, 2016 to Present
- Designing and developing the MSP En Español, MSP Recovery and MSP Recovery Law Firm websites usign Wordpress.
- Designing and developing the MSP Recovery Documentation website using MediaWiki. 
- Implementing web-based solution to manage Amazon Web Services (AWS) S3 files.
- Implementing web-based solution to manage Citrix ShareFile files using PHP and Java.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sofware Engineer - February, 2014 to May, 2016
- Worked with a team of website developers creating GUI and graphical display for web and mobile platforms working with many development tools, such as MySQL (query and management), MSSQL Server (queries), web development frameworks (Javascript, jQuery, PHP), and Javascript libraries (HighCharts, HighStock, ExtJS).
- Specializing in the development of responsive mobile website solutions using Sencha Touch.

company.name: University of Toronto/University of Havana/Ryerson University

positions.title: Assistant Professor and Researcher
positions.locationName: San Jose de las Lajas, Mayabeque
positions.description:
- Professor of Programing and Data Structures and Algorithms in Computer Engineering. 
- Member of the Research Group Business Process Management (PRONEG). Developer of Process Mining Algorithms.
- ACM-ICPC Executive Director at UNAH.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
Member of Datacimex's Viper Team. Development of Decision Support Systems about commerce and accounting with Pentaho BI Suite and PostgreSQL:
- Creating an open source web-based business intelligence solution for dynamic analysis of agregated data through the development of a data warehouse, ETL processes and reports. It included the use of PostgreSQL, Pentaho BI Suite, Kettle, Mondrian, JPivot.
- Implemented computational solution that offers CIMEX analysts and executives a business state overview to support decision making.
